name: Noszvaj (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Noszvaj: a crowned blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a pruning knife, above a scroll inscribed NOSZVAJ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Noszvaj arms with crown and scroll
